thread:
Noah Kim: Heads-up - HelixCare sent back the vendor risk form + DPA. Main blockers: non-prod access controls, embeddings retention policy (they want 30-day TTL), and SOC2 attestation scope (prod only vs prod+staging). They want a short demo + Q&A before renewal review. Form: <https://redwood.internal/docs/helixcare-dpa|helixcare-dpa.pdf>

Priya Singh: Got it. Do they require pseudonymization for embeddings or just encryption at rest? The form has a checkbox for 'pseudonymize before storage'.

Omar Diaz: We currently offer encryption at rest + tenant scoping metadata. Pseudonymization would require a pre-processing step on the customer side or a config in Private deployments. We can propose a managed pseudonymization flow as professional services.

Tess Alvarez: I can host the demo (20	15m) and run through our non-prod access model, role-based access, and how we handle test data. Need a sanitized dataset and an SRE snapshot for staging roles.

Noah Kim: Tentative slot: Tue 9:30am PT. @Priya @Omar please confirm by EOD. They also want SOC2 evidence (control descriptions + sample screenshots) uploaded before the meeting.

Priya Singh: I'll assemble SOC2 artifact set (control IDs: CC1, CC3, and PI-4 equivalents) and a short mapping doc. Will redact user identifiers.

legal-bot: Auto-note: DPA clause suggestion template applied. Recommended: limit subprocessor list to current + 30-day notice for additions.

Omar Diaz: On non-prod access - we can lock staging to allow only named engineers via SSO + ephemeral keys. Need SRE to export staging IAM role list. Timeline: 3-5 business days to gather screenshots and role mappings.

Tess Alvarez: Demo bullets I'll cover: 1) Embeddings lifecycle (creation, TTL, deletion API), 2) Non-prod access controls & examples, 3) Data residency options (US/EU routing).

Noah Kim: Quick Q for Legal: HelixCare marked BYOK as "optional" but prefers customer-managed keys. @legal-bot any concerns with a BYOK addendum?

legal-bot: BYOK addendum standard acceptable. Will prepare a short fall-back clause if BYOK can't be provisioned within timeline. Expect redline by tomorrow COB.

Priya Singh: I'll put the artifact zip into secure bucket /s3/secure-share/helixcare-soc2-414321 by EOD.

cs-bot: Reminder scheduled: "HelixCare enablement + DPA Q&A" on 2024-08-02 09:30 PT.

Noah Kim: Next steps: (1) @legal-bot finalize DPA redline, (2) @Priya drop SOC2 artifacts in secure bucket, (3) @Omar gather staging IAM screenshot, (4) @Tess prepare demo + request sanitized sample. I'll confirm meeting invite once items are green. Thanks! :wave:
